issues.message: Noncanonical compact authoring: Visible text requires one direct root font-family default; semantic groups and text elements keep only real overrides (advisory; normalize with `python3 scripts/compact_svg_styles.py <svg_output> --inplace`, re-stamp pages that carry Chart/Table fallbacks, and rerun the final gate, or leave the explicit form)
